notes.title: 2nd Year Anniversary Major Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

112 Operator is now 2 years old! The game was released on 23 Apr, 2020 and we have made several adjustments to the game since then, not to mention all 4 DLCs that were released afterward. We are very proud of this game and truly appreciate the dedicated community that has supported us since launch. 

This new major update comes from our desire to make the 112 Operator game more accessible. So we are following the previous updates and keep on changing the mid and late-game difficulty, improving the units' response to nearby events, and making all the vehicles come back to their original locations after solved incidents. This should not only help with keeping our units organized throughout harder duties but also further promote players who are taking their time to set everything up properly in the management phase. 

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new functionality, which makes all the units go back to their original location after solving the incident. 
[*] Added patrol checkbox option for medic and firefighting units. By default, these checkboxes are turned off. 
[*] Improved the auto "go to incident" area radius for the vehicle units. All units should auto-detect and go to nearby incidents more effectively now. 
[*] Improved the city search engine to locate cities more effectively.
[*] Improved the way scenario medals are being saved in the Steam Cloud.
[*] Improved the translation in the Polish language.
[*] Improved the efficiency of the dog units during the "search & rescue" incidents.  
[*] Rebalanced the number of water units acquired by the player. 
[*] Rebalanced the timeout of the water incidents.
[*] Rebalanced the quarantine chance and quarantine duration in the Pandemic Outbreak DLC. 
[*] Reduced the number of pandemic incidents in the Pandemic Outbreak DLC. 
[*] Rebalanced mid-game - lower number of incidents.  
[*] Rebalanced late-game - lower team members' upkeep cost, higher income. 
[*] Reduced the cost of the helicopters. 
[*] Minor changes to some events (daughter, mail about the VIP). 
[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented water units from auto-detecting nearby incidents. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the localization icon not moving to the incident location during the call. 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused team members to display in wrong categories under specific conditions. 
[*] Fixed an issue with units not being correctly displayed as unavailable due to weather under specific conditions. 
[*] Fixed the tutorial and some parts of it not displaying correctly. 
[*] Fixed an issue with loading screen videos displaying incorrectly on Steam Deck devices. 
[*] Several minor bugs have been fixed.
[*] Several minor UI adjustments have been implemented.
[/list]
[/expand]
[h2]More to come![/h2]
Hopefully, you will find all those changes to your liking. We are aware that some of those new mechanics might require getting used to, but in the end, they should make the whole experience a bit more balanced, smooth, and not as overwhelming as it could have been in the past. Let us know what you think about this update!

And on a side note - expect another great news coming your way next week! 

Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

notes.title: 11.10.2021 - Major Rebalance Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators! [/h2]

As you have probably noticed, we are recently working hard on finding that sweet spot where the game is fun for everyone. That's why today's patch is a major one that concludes the main changes to the game's difficulty. If you haven't played 112 Operator in a long time or if you have given up because the game was too stressful or not rewarding enough - it might be a great moment to give it another go. Of course, we will still tweak some things here and there, but we are really interested in your feedback about the current state of the game.

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced the promotion bonuses that were granted to the players. The player is going to receive fewer vehicles, while being given more money to make his own upgrade choices.
[*] Rebalanced personnel upkeep cost. The personnel cost at the later stages of the game should be noticeably lower now. 
[*] Updated the reinforcement, now it is possible to send them directly to the incident's scene. 
[*] Fixed an issue with cursor behaviour when playing on fullscreen mode with a double monitor setup.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused an error when searching for smaller cities in South Korea. 
[/list]
[h2]Infection Free Zone Kickstarter campaign is now 70% funded[/h2]
The team that has worked on 911 Operator and 112 Operator for the past few years is now working on a new project - [b]Infection Free Zone[/b]. [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gameops/infection-free-zone-city-survival-with-real-maps?ref=d8sqpw]Join us on Kickstarter[/url] and support this new, incredible game! notes.title: The Last Duty #Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

Although it says "Hotfix" in the title, this patch is a major one and it addresses a lot of your reports. The recent ones, related to the DLC itself, but it also changes the gameplay balance, according to feedback that we are receiving for a long time now. 

Many players felt frustrated by the number of incidents happening in the game, especially when the first few duties were over. We have received videos with hundred incident icons appearing on screen and many reviews that the game is too nervous, tiring, and stressful. And while we were aiming for this experience to be somehow real, we probably went too far with it. We tried introducing some new commands, like "SetIncidentMultiplier" and new options for the free game mode, but the feedback stayed the same. That's why we have decided to rebalance the game difficulty on a normal difficulty level. It might not be the final iteration of it, but hopefully, we are going in the right direction. 

Mind you, if you were a fan of the game being complex - hard and expert difficulty levels were barely changed, which means that people who are up for the challenge can still have their fun! 

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Game's difficulty has been rebalanced, especially on the normal difficulty level. 
[*] The Last Duty scenario difficulty has been rebalanced.
[*] New army vehicles have been added in The Last Duty scenario.
[*] Thai fonts have been added to the game. 
[*] Units won't be sent to quarantine anymore after the pandemic events are over.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused helicopters' position to reset after each duty.
[*] Fixed an issue with custom facilities preventing the players from losing the game during the Last Duty scenario.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from finishing the riot and tornado events. 
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from finishing a duty, when certain criteria were met. 
[/list]
 
Let us know how you feel about the changes! Hopefully, we can make 112 Operator a more accessible game now, making it more comfortable for the players who felt overwhelmed by the numbers of incidents popping all over the map. 

Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

notes.title: 09.04.2021 - Major Spring Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Operators![/h3]

Major Spring Update for 112 Operator is out now on Steam! 🌱

[h3]Update Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Two new languages have been officially added to the game - Japanese and Brazilian Portuguese.
[*] Some of the biggest Chinese cities have been added to the Workshop - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2435151447]Chinese Cities Part 1[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2435228899]Chinese Cities Part 2[/url].
[/list]
First of all, we want to say "Thank you!" to the people who are working on fan translations. We have been in contact with the authors of Japanese and Brazilian Portuguese translation for some time now and we have decided to include their work as official translations for 112 Operator. Thanks to them, you will also have the newest DLC - Pandemic Outbreak - translated to those languages on the very first day of the DLC's launch. Great job! 

Another important topic was the issue with some Chinese players being unable to download maps in the free-play mode. That's why we have decided to put some of the biggest Chinese cities in the Workshop. We hope that this workaround solution will allow you to play on those maps without any in-game loading issues. Accordingly to the popularity of this Workshop entry, we will add more cities for download in the future.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to edit the default and existing gears. Workarounds based on duplicating and creating new gears aren't required anymore. 
[*] Added purchasable harbors for players who have both DLCs - Facilities and Water Operations.
[*] Team members will take off their gears now when going to the hospital. 
[*] SetIncidentsMultiplier slider has been added to the free game initial screen. Console command isn't the only option anymore.
[*] Added new "wait for backup" functionality. Sending a police unit to the incident, while pressing the ALT key will result in the police unit waiting on-site for other police units to arrive, before taking any further action. 
[/list]
[h3]Bug fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with backup events appearing for players, who don't have a sufficient number of units to complete such an event. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the water landing event, which prevented the player from finishing a duty.
[*] Fixed an issue with water districts' stats appearing incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue with scenes, where the fire was being set up in the water areas.
[*] Fixed an issue with vehicles in reserve being filtered in an incorrect way.
[*] Fixed an issue with gear duplicating.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented some units from taking a handcuffed criminal from a scene.
[*] Other small changes and fixes.
[/list]
We hope that this update will make your 112 Operator experience even better than ever before. The Pandemic Outbreak DLC is currently in the last testing phase, so prepare for the launch date announcement soon! Stay tuned, Operators! 

Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

notes.title: Water Operations Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
Greetings, Operators!

Water Operations Hotfix #2 is out now on Steam. 🌊 This time with even more improvements to the game! 

Full list of changes:
[list]
[*] Loading speed of huge maps with water tiles has been vastly improved.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented DLC Water Operations scenarios from loading up under specific circumstances.
[*] Fixed an issue with Water Ambulance reinforcements, where the units weren't taking action as intended.
[*] New "R" shortcut button has been added. The button orders currently selected units to go back to their starting location. 
[*] Units that got buried in snow on their road to incident will now start to move again after they unbury themselves. 
[*] Water vehicles bonuses received significant improvements. 
[*] Fixed an issue where excessive amounts of emails about unlocked amphibious vehicles were sent to the player. 
[*] Water landing will appear on the largest body of water in the area now.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused a loading error after adding a district with no roads set up in their area.
[*] SetIncidentsMultiplier console command has been added. Players can now adjust the amount of incidents that spawn during the duty. Examples - "SetIncidentsMultiplier 3" will cause 3 times more incidents, but typing in "SetIncidentsMultiplier 0.25" will result in 4 times less incidents overall. Reminder - to open the console, press "~" key during the game. You will also need to type the "EnableCheats" command first. 
[/list]
If you always felt overwhelmed by the amount of incidents in later stages of the game, we encourage you to try the "SetIncidentsMultiplier" console command. It should vastly improve the gameplay experience for players who are looking for a more relaxing pace! 

Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team
